# Jeffrey M. Goldberg Law Offices

> > Chicago-based personal injury law firm specializing in birth injury, medical malpractice, and premises liability cases throughout Illinois and Wisconsin.

Jeffrey M. Goldberg Law Offices (Goldberg & Schulkin) represents clients in complex medical malpractice cases, with particular expertise in birth trauma, cerebral palsy, and maternal mortality claims. The firm handles personal injury matters including rideshare accidents and premises liability throughout the Chicago area.

## Key Topics

- Birth Injury & Birth Trauma
- Medical Malpractice
- Cerebral Palsy
- Maternal Mortality & Pregnancy Complications
- Erb's Palsy & Brachial Plexus Injury
- HELLP Syndrome
- Jaundice & Hyperbilirubinemia
- Premises Liability
- Rideshare Accidents (Uber/Lyft)
- Illinois & Wisconsin Personal Injury Law
- Nurse Negligence
- Expert Witness Standards (Daubert)
- Pharmaceutical Litigation (Zofran)
- Chicago Legal Services
